d: In the aftermath of severe flooding triggered by a cyclone in Odisha’s Ganjam district, a high-stakes standoff erupted between local administration and political leadership. BJP MLA from Aska, Saroj Kumar Padhi, allegedly verbally abused and issued death threats to 2022-batch IAS officer and Ganjam CDO Samir Jena over the distribution of relief materials. The incident took place inside the executive officer's chamber and was reportedly captured on CCTV. While the officer lodged a formal police complaint citing trauma and seeking protection, opposition BJD demanded strict action, even as…
